requirements.label: Served injunction decree
requirements.description: Presence of the decree or a document citing its details and content.
requirements.suggestion: Upload the served injunction decree or relevant court docket file.

requirements.label: Date of service / notification
requirements.description: Date from which deadlines for opposition or defensive actions run.
requirements.suggestion: Upload proof of service, certified email delivery receipt, or service certificate.

requirements.label: Parties to the proceeding
requirements.suggestion: Upload the decree, application, or memorandum identifying the parties.

requirements.label: Grounds for opposition
requirements.description: Facts or documents supporting challenges and defenses.
requirements.suggestion: Upload proof of payment, dispute notices, contracts, defenses, or objections.

requirements.label: Opposition operational deadline
requirements.description: Internal reminder on statutory deadline or countdown.
requirements.suggestion: Add a deadline calculation note after verifying the service date.

requirements.label: Creditor or claimant
requirements.description: Identification of the entity asserting the monetary claim.
requirements.suggestion: Upload a document or memo identifying the creditor/claimant.

requirements.label: Debtor or respondent
requirements.description: Identification of the party against whom the claim is brought.
requirements.suggestion: Upload a document or memo identifying the debtor/defendant.

requirements.label: Claim amount
requirements.description: Requested principal amount or total claim indicated in the file.
requirements.suggestion: Upload invoices, account statements, or principal/interest calculations.

requirements.label: Written proof of debt
requirements.description: Document supporting the claim: invoice, contract, purchase order, delivery note, or statement.
requirements.suggestion: Upload written proof of debt and verify legibility and debtor linkage.

requirements.label: Due date or maturity
requirements.description: Date indicating when the claim became due and payable.
requirements.suggestion: Upload invoice due date, payment terms, or document proving maturity.

requirements.label: Demand letter or notice of default
requirements.description: Useful element for calculating interest, strategy, and pre-litigation posture.
requirements.suggestion: Upload any demand letters, default notices, or payment reminders already sent.

requirements.label: Parties involved
requirements.description: Principal parties in the matter file.
requirements.suggestion: Upload an intake memo or pleading identifying the parties.

requirements.label: Key dates
requirements.description: Basic timeline of events and statutory dates.
requirements.suggestion: Upload dated documents or a case timeline.

requirements.label: Key documents
requirements.description: Pleadings, contracts, correspondence, or core exhibits.
requirements.suggestion: Upload the primary matter documents with descriptive titles.

requirements.label: Economic value
requirements.description: Amounts, principal, rent, damages, or monetary items.
requirements.suggestion: Upload damage calculations, invoices, or financial ledgers if applicable.
